name: Bastion
concept: The Sentinel: more Guards than anyone, a Counter on every Pressure, blocks that win the next round too, and a grey cap of 6: hits trickle through him, but there is never a big opening. Repulse (his own Guard) Staggers a Pressure it beats; Rim Shot ends his combos; the Aegis special knocks down; the Final Bastion Super leaves them Dizzy.

cards.name: Repulse
cards.flavour: Turn the blow aside and step in.

cards.name: Recall
cards.flavour: Cover up, then bring back what you need.

cards.name: Charge
cards.flavour: Cover up and build the bar.

cards.name: Aegis
cards.flavour: Plant the shield: whatever hits it goes down.

super.name: Final Bastion
super.flavour: Once a game: the wall that leaves them reeling.

notes: v19 (8 November 2026, evening): the overflow grey cap (the pile stops at the cap, grey beyond it is lost as HP) and a Convert cashes only as the clash card, so no Convert is a Linker or Ender (Mark). Every HP 2 lower to bring time-outs back into the band. Shoulder Ram and Shield Slam lose Ender, so Rim Shot gains it (x3, from x2); Repulse x1 (from x2), so 8 Guards. His own grey cap: 6 (his mirror timed out 24-54% without it, 8% with). HP 36. v19 tuning: HP 38. v19 test (8 November 2026): Counter icons only on Pressures (Mark), played with the grey cap (9). Moved from the v18 file: every Convert loses Counter; Edge Jab, Sonic Cutter gain it. Rules v18, 8 November 2026 (afternoon), Mark: better attacks, Knockdown on Lockdown (throws usually knock down) and HP 36. Edge Jab 17, Shield Bash 15 (Starter, Linker, Counter), Rim Shot 14 (Build 4, chip 1); Lockdown On hit: Knockdown.
